secret_like.description: Content that looks like a password or a credential. A client must ask the user before saving it, and must not silently drop it. A match on any pattern counts. Only text of at most `max_length_checked` characters after trimming is checked; longer text never counts, except for a pattern marked `any_length`, which is checked on text of any length. `regex` is written without inline flags so every language can compile it; `flags: i` means match without regard to case.

patterns.name: single_dense_string
patterns.description: One line, no spaces, 12 to 64 characters, with a lower-case letter, an upper-case letter, a digit and a symbol, and not a URL.

save_messages.description: The one sentence a saving client shows. The core returns the key and the text.

duplicate.zh: 之前存过了，没有重复存。

saved_image_skipped_quota.zh: 已存入。图片没存入：超出存储配额。
saved_image_skipped_quota.en: Saved. The image was not stored: storage quota exceeded.

queued_offline.zh: 还没存入，排着队，联网后自动存入。
queued_offline.en: Not saved yet. Queued, and it will be saved when you are back online.

queued_not_connected.zh: 还没存入，排着队，接入后自动存入。
queued_not_connected.en: Not saved yet. Queued, and it will be saved once this device is connected.

secret_like_question.zh: 这段内容看起来像密码或凭据，还要存入吗？
secret_like_question.en: This looks like a password or a credential. Save it anyway?

one_analysis.en: The analysis of “{title}” is ready. You can see the verdict.

one_deep_read.zh: 「{title}」的精读好了，可以去深挖队列看精读。
one_deep_read.en: The deep read of “{title}” is ready. See it in the deep-dive queue.

many_analysis.zh: {n} 条的解读好了，可以去看。

many_deep_read.zh: {n} 条的精读好了，可以去看。

push_payload.description: The JSON a device receives in a notification. `body` is the sentence to show. `count` is how many items it covers. `item_id` is set when it covers exactly one item (open that item); otherwise open the today view. `kind` is `analysis`, `deep_read` or `mixed`.

opening_line.description: What a user sends to a chat assistant to start a deep dive. It carries no content; the assistant fetches it.
